acceptance.title: Kugamuchira Mamiriro
acceptance.content: Mamiriro aya eKushandisa anoita chibvumirano chinosungirira pakati penyu neIPEACE Professional Consulting ('IPEACE' kana 'isu') kana muchishandisa webhusaiti yedu, kubhuka kubvunzurudza, kana kugamuchira masevhisi edu ekubvunzurudza bhizinesi. Nekudaro, munogamuchira mamiriro aya nemitemo yeZimbabwe inoshanda, kusanganisira Electronic Transactions and Electronic Commerce Act [Chapter 8:13] pakutaurirana nekuita zvibvumirano zvemagetsi. Kana musingabvumi, musashandise masevhisi edu.

useOfService.title: Kushandisa Masevhisi Edu
useOfService.content: Munogona kushandisa webhusaiti nemasevhisi edu chete pazvinangwa zvebhizinesi zviri pamutemo. Munofanira kupa ruzivo rwenyu uyerwe kambani rwechokwadi, kupa zvinyorwa zvinokumbirwa nenguva yakakodzera, uye muchengete mutoro wezvisarudzo nezvinyorwa zvepamutemo zvinoitwa zvenyu. Musashandise masevhisi edu kuti:
prohibited: Muputse mutemo upi zvawo kana mutemo weZimbabwe
Muputse kodzero dzeintellectual property, kuvanzika, kana kuchengetedzwa kwemavanzo
Mutume software yakaipa kana kodhi inokuvadza
Muite tsotsi, kunyengedza, kana mabasa anonyengedza
Mukanganise kuchengetedzeka, kushanda, kana kuvimbika kwemasevhisi edu

intellectualProperty.title: Intellectual Property
intellectualProperty.content: Zviri pa webhusaiti yedu, branding, nzira dzedu dzekushanda, template nemamwe zvinyorwa ndezvaIPEACE kana vakatipa mvumo, uye zvinochengetedzwa neCopyright and Neighbouring Rights Act yeZimbabwe [Chapter 26:05] nemimwe mitemo inoshanda. Mushure mekubhadhara zvizere, munogona kushandisa zvinyorwa zvatakagadzirirwa imwi pabasa renyu remukati mebhizinesi. Hamubvumirwi kuteedzera, kutengesa, kana kuparadzira zvinhu zvedu pasina mvumo yedu yakanyorwa.

termination.title: Kumisidzira nekupedzisa Basa
termination.content: Bato ripi zvaro rinogona kupedzisa basa nechiziviso chakanyorwa. Tinogona kumisidzira kana kupedzisa kubvumidzwa kwenyu pakarepo kana muputsa mamiriro aya, kuneta kubhadhara mari yakabvumiranwa, kana kushandisa masevhisi edu zvisiri pamutemo. Munochengeta mutoro wemari nemutengo wakabvumirana webasa rakaitwa kusvika pazuva rekupedzisira. Mamiriro ane chekuita neintellectual property, kuchengetedza mavanzo, nemhosho anoramba achishanda mushure mekupedzisira.

disclaimer.title: Ruzivo rweHunyanzvi uye Disclaimer
disclaimer.content: Zviri pa webhusaiti ruzivo rwakajairika rwebhizinesi nekutevera mitemo, kwete zano remutemo, mitero, investimendi kana rimwe zano rakagadzirirwa zvokwenyu. Tinoita basa nesungwaru nemhindu kodi yakakodzera, asi hativimbisi zvisarudzo kana mvumo dzeDeeds Registry, ZIMRA, makanzuru emunharaunda kana rimwe bato remutemo. Kunze kwekodzero dzisingabviswi pasi peConsumer Protection Act yeZimbabwe [Chapter 14:44], masevhisi edu eonline anopiwa 'sezviri' uye 'sezvainowanikwa'.

limitationOfLiability.title: Kudzikisira Mhosho
limitationOfLiability.content: Sezvinobvumidzwa nemutemo weZimbabwe, IPEACE haina mhosho yekurasikirwa kwakanangana, kwechingangoitika, kwakakosha, kwekutevera kana kurangwa, kusanganisira kurasikirwa neprofit, data kana mikana yebhizinesi, kunobva nekushandisa masevhisi edu. Hapana chiri mumamiriro aya chinobvisa kana kudzikisira mhosho yetsotsi, kushaya hanya kukuru, rufu kana kukuvara kwevanhu, kana mhosho isingabviswi nemutemo, kusanganisira pasi peConsumer Protection Act [Chapter 14:44].

governingLaw.title: Mutemo Unoshanda uye Kupesana
governingLaw.content: Mamiriro aya anotongwa nemitemo yeZimbabwe. Mapato achatanga nekuedza kugadzirisa gakava nekutaurirana kwakanaka. Kana gakava risina kugadziriswa, makoreti eZimbabwe anokodzera achatonga, zvichienderana nechero chibvumirano chakanyorwa chekupedzisa gakava nearbitration pasi peArbitration Act [Chapter 7:15].

changesToTerms.title: Shanduko kumamiriro Aya
changesToTerms.content: Tinogona kugadzirisa mamiriro aya nekuisa vhezheni itsva nekuchinja zuva rekuti 'Yakapedzisira kugadziriswa'. Kana paine shanduko huru, tinogona kuzivisa vatengi vakanyoresa neemail. Kuramba muchishandisa webhusaiti kana masevhisi edu mushure mezuva rekutangiswa kunoreva kugamuchira. Shanduko hadzichinji chibvumirano chakasainiwa pabasa rakapfuura kunze kwekunge mapato ose abvuma nekunyora.

contact.title: Ruzivo rweKutibata
contact.content: Kana muine mibvunzo pamusoro peMamiriro aya eKushandisa, ndapota tibatei muchishandisa ruzivo rwuri pazasi:

introduction.title: Nhanganyaya
introduction.content: IPEACE Professional Consulting inoremekedza kuvanzika kwenyu uye inoshandisa ruzivo rwemunhu zvichienderana neCyber and Data Protection Act yeZimbabwe [Chapter 12:07]. Pasi peMutemo uyu, IPEACE ndiyo data controller yeruzivo rwutsanangurwa mummutemo uyu. Postal and Telecommunications Regulatory Authority of Zimbabwe (POTRAZ) ndiyo bato rechengetedzo yedata munyika.

personal.title: Ruzivo rwemunhu uyerwe Bhizinesi
personal.content: Tinounganidza ruzivo rwamunotipa kana muchibvunza, kubhuka kubvunzurudza, kunyoresa client portal, kana kushandisa masevhisi edu, kusanganisira:
examples: Mazita, ruzivo rwekuzivisa, email, nharembozha, uye kero dzemumugara
Ruzivo rwekunyoresa kambani, vatungamiriri, shareholders, mitero uye rezinesi

usage.title: Ruzivo rweTekiniki uyerwe Kushandisa
usage.content: Kana muchishandisa webhusaiti yedu, tinogona kuunganidza ruzivo rwashoma rwetekiniki, kusanganisira:
examples: Rudzi rwe browser, operating system, nechishandiso
IP address, nzvimbo yemungava pedyo, uye nguva dzekupinda
Mapeji amunosvika, zvamunoita, uye nguva yamunopedza pawebhusaiti yedu

howWeUseInformation.title: Kuti Tinoshandisirei Ruzivo Rwenyu
howWeUseInformation.content: Tinoshandisa ruzivo rwemunhu chete kana tine hwaro hwe pamutemo, semvumo yenyu, kuita chibvumirano, kutevera chido chepamutemo, kana zvinangwa zvedu zvebhizinesi zviri pamutemo. Tinorushandisa kuti:
purposes: Tipe, titungamirire uye tivandudze masevhisi edu ekubvunzurudza
Tipindure mibvunzo uye titungamirire kubhuka kwekubvunzurudza
Titume shanduko dze masevhisi nekushambadzira kwatenderwa, nemvumo painodiwa
Tigadzirire kunyoresa, kuisa zvinyorwa nemamwe mirayiro yamunokumbira
Titevere zvinodiwa pamitero, accounting, kambani, anti-money-laundering nemimwe mitemo
Tichengetedze masisitimu edu, tidzivirire kushandiswa zvisizvo, uye tinzwisise mashandiro ewebhusaiti

dataProtection.title: Kuchengetedzwa kweData uye Kugadziriswa kweBreaches
dataProtection.content: Tinoshandisa nzira dzakakodzera dzetekiniki nedzesangano, kusanganisira access controls nekutumira zvakachengetedzeka, kuchengetedza ruzivo rwemunhu pakupinda kwasatenderwa, kurasikirwa, kuchinjwa kana kuziviswa. Vanhu vatenderwa chete nevabatsiri vemasevhisi vanorupinda kune zvinangwa zviri mummutemo uyu. Kana zvichidikanwa neCyber and Data Protection Act, tichazivisa POTRAZ nevanhu vakabatikana ne data breach inosangodza.

sharingOfInformation.title: Kugoverana uye Kushandiswa Kunze kwenyika
sharingOfInformation.content: Hatitengesi kana kuhayiridza ruzivo rwemunhu. Tinogona kuruzarura chete mumamiriro aya, tichishandisa zvibvumirano kana dzimwe nzira dzakakodzera dzekuchengetedza kana ruzivo ruchishandiswa kunze kweZimbabwe:
cases: Nevatengesi vekutenda ve hosting, email, payment nevamwe vanoshanda nemirayiro yedu
Nemakoreti, mapurisa, ZIMRA, Deeds Registry kana mamwe mapato kana zvichidikanwa kana kutenderwa nemutemo
Nevaongorori vehunyanzvi kana mugamuchiri mu merger, restructuring kana kutamidzirwa kwebhizinesi, nekuchengetedza mavanzo
Nemvumo yenyu yakajeka kana nemirayiro yenyu pazvinangwa zvakatarwa

yourRights.title: Kodzero Dzenyu dzeKuchengetedzwa kweData
yourRights.content: Zvichienderana neCyber and Data Protection Act uye zvakabviswa zviri pamutemo, munogona kushandisa kodzero dziri pazasi nekutibata. Munogona kubvisa mvumo nguva ipi zvayo pasina kukanganisa kushandiswa kwatangoitwa pamutemo, uye munogona kuisa chinyororo kuPOTRAZ kana mufunga kuti ruzivo rwenyu rwashandiswa zvisiri pamutemo:
rights: Kukumbira kupinda nekugamuchira kopi yeruzivo rwenyu
Kukumbira kugadziriswa kweruzivo rwusiri rwechokwadi kana rwusina kuzara
Kukumbira kudzimwa kana ruzivo rwuchisichidiwa pamutemo
Kuramba kana kukumbira kumisidzwa kwekushandiswa kumwe, kusanganisira direct marketing
Kukumbira kutakurwa kweruzivo rwamakapa, kana zvingaitwe nemutemo netekinoroji

dataRetention.title: Kuchengeta Data
dataRetention.content: Tinochengeta ruzivo rwemunhu chete nguva inodiwa pazvinangwa zvarwakauunganidzirwa, pabasa redu nesu, uye pazvinodiwa zve limitation, mitero, accounting nekuchengeta zvinyorwa zvekambani. Kana rwuchisichidiwa, tinorudzima, kuparadza kana kuita kuti rusazivikanwe zvakachengetedzeka.

cookies.title: Cookies neTekinoroji Yakafanana
cookies.content: Tinoshandisa cookies dzakakosha pakuchengetedza, authentication uye mashandiro akakosha ewebhusaiti. Kana tichishandisa analytics dzisina kumanikidzwa kana tekinoroji yakafanana, tinodaro zvichienderana nezvinodiwa zvemvumo. Munogona kutonga kana kudzima cookies pa browser yenyu, asi kuvhara cookies dzakakosha kunogona kukanganisa client portal nedzimwe mashandiro.

thirdPartyLinks.title: Mabatanidzwa eVamwe Vanhu
thirdPartyLinks.content: Webhusaiti yedu inogona kuve nemabatanidzwa ewebhusaiti kana masevhisi evamwe. Kushandiswa kwavo kunoenderana nemitemo yavo yekuvanzika, uye IPEACE haina mutoro wezvavo kana maitiro avo. Ndapota verengai mitemo yavo musati mupa ruzivo rwemunhu.

childrenPrivacy.title: Kuvanzika kweVana
childrenPrivacy.content: Masevhisi edu akagadzirirwa mabhizinesi nevanhu vakuru vane makore 18 kana kupfuura. Hatizivi kuti tinounganidza ruzivo rwemunhu kubva kuvana. Kana mufunga kuti mwana apa ruzivo pasina mvumo inodiwa, tibatei kuti tiongorore uye tirudzime kana zvichikodzera.

changesToPolicy.title: Shanduko kuMutemo Uyu weKuvanzika
changesToPolicy.content: Tinogona kugadzirisa mutemo uyu kuratidza shanduko kumasevhisi edu kana zvinodiwa nemutemo. Tichaisa mutemo wakagadziriswa nekuchinja zuva rekuti 'Yakapedzisira kugadziriswa', uye tinogona kupa rimwe chiziviso che shanduko huru. Mutemo wakagadziriswa unobva wanga watanga kushanda pazuva rakabudiswa.

contact.title: Tibatei
contact.content: Pemibvunzo yekuvanzika, zvikumbiro zve data subjects, kana kunetseka nekushandiswa kwedu kweruzivo rwemunhu, tibatei pakero iri pazasi. Kana musingagutsikani nemhinduro yedu, munogona kutakura chinyororo chenyu kuPOTRAZ:

faq.title: Mibvunzo Inowanzo Bvunzwa: Kutevedzera Mitemo Yebhizinesi muZimbabwe
faq.subtitle: Wana mhinduro dzemibvunzo inowanzo bvunzwa pamusoro pekutanga nekumhanyisa bhizinesi muZimbabwe

questions.question: Ndinoregistera kambani muZimbabwe sei?
questions.answer: Kuti uregister kambani muZimbabwe, unofanira: 1) Kusarudza zita rekambani risina kufanana, 2) Kugadzira Memorandum and Articles of Association, 3) Kufaila kuCompanies Office, 4) Kuwana tax clearance certificate, uye 5) Kunyoresa kuitira VAT kana zvichidikanwa. System yedu inogona kukutungamira munzvimbo imwe neimwe.

questions.question: Zvinodiwa zvekutevera mitemo yekambani muZimbabwe ndezvi?
questions.answer: Kambani dzeZimbabwe dzinofanira kutevera: Companies Act Chapter 24:03, kufaila annual returns, director's reports, audited financial statements, kutevera mitemo yemitero, uye mitemo yemaindasitiri akasiyana. Tinopa machecklist ekutevera mitemo uye kuongorora kwakakwana.

questions.question: Kunyoresa kambani muZimbabwe kunodhura marii?
questions.answer: Mari yekunyoresa kambani inochinja zvichienderana nerudzi: Private companies (~$50-200 USD), Public companies (~$500+ USD), pamwe nemamwe mari yemafees emagweta, tax clearance, uye mabusiness license. Tinopa mapakeji ekunyoresa anodhura zvakanaka ane zvinyorwa zvese zvinodikanwa.

questions.question: Mabusiness license api andinoda muZimbabwe?
questions.answer: Mamwe maresense anodiwa anoenderana nerudzi rwebhizinesi rako: Trading License kubva kukanseri yemunharaunda, Tax Clearance Certificate, kunyoresa kweVAT (kana turnover >$60,000), Mamwe maresense emaindasitiri akasiyana (mining, tourism, nezvimwewo). Tinobatsira kuwana uye kuwana maresense ese anodiwa.

questions.question: Munogona kutibatsira sei nekutevera mitemo yebhizinesi muZimbabwe?
questions.answer: Tinopa: kuongorora kutevera mitemo kwemaawa 24/7, kuongorora zvinyorwa otomatiki, zvitsva zvemitemo, kuongorora njodzi, mibvunzo yemutemo yekukurumidza, uye pfungwa dzekufembera kutevera mitemo dzakadzidziswa pane framework yemitemo yeZimbabwe.

questions.question: Zvirango zvekutevera mitemo muZimbabwe ndezvi?
questions.answer: Zvirango zvinosanganisira mafines kusvika ku$500,000, kugara mujeri kusvika kumakore 5, kuvharwa kwebhizinesi, kudzimwa kwedirector, uye kukuvara kwezita. Tinobatsira mabhizinesi kuchengetedza chiyero chekutevera mitemo che99.8% kuburikidza nekuongorora kwekare.
